description: Change one of your marketplace listings: pass listing_id and at least one of is_public, commission_rate and min_payout_threshold. Making a private listing public runs the marketplace review first; a function that fails it stays as it was and the refusal carries the report. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

commission_rate.description: The share of each sale the marketplace keeps.

listing_id.description: The marketplace listing: its id, as list_my_marketplace_listings shows it.

min_payout_threshold.description: The least balance that is paid out.

name: update_marketplace_listing
